description:
Hourly ceiling rates that GSA has awarded on federal schedule contracts (CALC+), searched by labor category text, e.g. 'systems engineer' or 'program manager'. Returns a price summary over every match (count, min, p25, median, p75, max, data date) plus up to 50 matching rates, lowest first, each with vendor, contract number, SIN, education and minimum experience. Use it for independent government cost estimates and price-reasonableness checks. Optional filters: sin, education (e.g. Bachelors, Masters, PhD), min_years_experience.
FREE tier: 20 calls per visitor per 24h. A GlobalGov plan with API access lifts the cap.

min_years_experience.description: Only rates requiring at least this many years.

sin.description: GSA Special Item Number filter, e.g. 54151S.

name: search_labor_rates
title: Search GSA labor rates
